scope: Renderer scheduling and current-stage reuse only; source unit/type checks and actual source-bundled Chromium fixture, not final production package verification.

verification.command: pnpm exec vitest run tests/mercy-demand-renderer.test.ts tests/mercy-world.test.ts

behavior: One outstanding requestAnimationFrame at most; no idle polling. Input, stage/choice updates, resize and camera controls wake rendering.
Movement and camera settling continue until at rest. Document visibility and actual canvas intersection pause scheduling. Logical staging metadata updates even offscreen.
Prepared current targets and Blaise limbs are cached outside frames; unchanged fixture values avoid DOM writes and projection serialization.
One live environment only. Reuse requires exact location, gathered-resident condition, ordered props and ordered actor transforms. Changed staging releases the old environment.

Shadow map updates on avatar pose and stage changes; camera-only and settling frames reuse current shadows. Original pixel ratio, materials, geometry, lighting, antialiasing, tone mapping and shadow settings retained.
limits: Chromium software WebGL; no hardware frame-rate or device benchmark.
Document-hidden visibility is simulated in the fixture; canvas-offscreen behavior uses real browser scroll/intersection.
Root owns independent final production browser comparison and package verification.
